item.title: Spitzer named SLC Soccer Student-Athlete of the Year; five Demons earn All-Academic honors
item.description: As talented as Northwestern State senior defender Jessica Spitzer has been on the soccer field, she is even better in the classroom. Spitzer was named the Southland Conference Soccer Student-Athlete of the Year Monday, leading five Demons on the All-SLC Academic Team. item.title: Temporary Church Street Bridge closure for Christmas light removal morning of January 14
item.description: The City of Natchitoches announced a temporary closure of the Church Street Bridge on Wednesday, Jan. 14 from 8:30 a.m. – 12 p.m. The closure is necessary for the Utility Department to remove the city’s Christmas lights from the bridge.
